Name: Lumisteria Magic Field
Author: Lumisteria
TagLine: Fight waves of monsters in a new location.
Description:
Fight waves of monsters in a new location.

This mod adds a new location, the Magic Field. Every evening, the old magic attracts waves of monsters for you to fight.

The access to the location is hidden somewhere in the valley.

Clue 1
Search in the Mine.

Clue 2
  There is someone near the entrance.

Then you'll have to pay a cost to enter. There is a clue in a book nearby, but you'll need to be able to read a strange language. The passage must be opened each day.

Monsters will spawn between 6 PM and 11 PM, and only if a player is in the location. If the monsters are too strong, use this to your advantage : retreat and come back later.
